title: The Slower Ball — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
You grip it differently, you release it the same way
Everything about the body says express
And then the ball arrives at a different speed to the one he expected

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
遅い球は時間についての会話だ [The slower ball is a conversation about time]
自分がどれだけ速いと思っているかについて [About how fast you think you are]
そして実際にどれだけ速いかについて [And how fast you actually are]
これらは頻繁に二つの異なることだ [Those are frequently two different things]

[Chorus — English]
The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting
The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it
The slower ball says — you've made up your mind already
The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it

[Bridge — 中文]
大多数击球手知道慢球要来了 [Most batsmen know the slower ball is coming]
这不是重点 [That's not the point]
重点是知道它要来了但仍然没有准备好 [The point is knowing it's coming and still not being ready]
那就是慢球 [That's the slower ball]
那就是慢球的意义 [That's the point of the slower ball]

[Verse 3 — English]
Most batsmen know the slower ball is coming
That's not the point
The point is knowing it's coming and still not being ready

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The slower ball
遅い球 [The slower ball]
慢球 [The slower ball]
That's my boy
